source.title: Erratum in ‘Open problems in some competition models’ by S. Elaydi and R. Luís

trace.notes: Resolved the supplied zbMATH record to the exact-work open-access DigitUMa PDF of the erratum. The chosen primary source is a two-page PDF containing journal front matter, the erratum text, and references.

No explicit or implicit open research problems were extractable from the chosen primary source. The erratum only corrects the condition in Theorem 1.1 from 0 < a, b < 1 to ab < 1 and a, b > 0 and then cites the original article and a related accepted paper.
Saved exact JSON to outputs/parse-paper/erratum-in-open-problems-in-some-competition-models.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
